message:
✝️ *SUNDAY INSPIRATION*

Scripture reminds us to use our gifts to serve others (1 Peter 4:10). At Korlink Technologies, learning is about more than technical skills—it is developing wisdom and discipline with a clear purpose. Every concept you master equips you to solve real-world problems and uplift those around you. 

As a new week begins, approach your training with focus and heart, knowing your dedication will become a blessing to others.

💭 *Reflection:*

How can the skills you learn this week be used to serve others?

☀️ *KORLINK DAILY TECH POLL*

🎓 *Cybersecurity*

👀 *Let's see who gets this!*

👉 *Question:*

You downloaded a PDF lecture note from an online link, but you notice the file name ends with '.pdf.exe'. What should you do?

1️⃣ Open it quickly to check if the notes are inside.
2️⃣ Delete it immediately without opening it.
3️⃣ Rename it to just '.pdf' so it opens as a document.
4️⃣ Forward it to a friend to test if it opens on their phone.

👇 *Drop your answer number and why below.*

💡 _Don't be afraid to get it wrong. The goal is to learn!_

🌙 *KORLINK ANSWER*

🎓 *Cybersecurity*

❓ *Today's Question:*

You downloaded a PDF lecture note from an online link, but you notice the file name ends with '.pdf.exe'. What should you do?

✅ *Correct Answer:*

2️⃣ Delete it immediately without opening it.

🧠 *Why?*

Files ending in '.exe' are program files that can run harmful code on your computer. Hackers often add '.pdf' in front of '.exe' to trick you into opening a virus.

🚀 *BONUS CHALLENGE:*

Do you know how to turn on 'File Name Extensions' on your computer so hidden extensions like .exe always show up?

🔥 _Keep learning. Keep practicing. Keep building!_

☀️ *KORLINK DAILY TECH POLL*

🎓 *Cybersecurity*

👀 *Let's see who gets this!*

👉 *Question:*

You suddenly receive a text message with a login security code for your email account, but you didn't try to log in. What should you do right away?

1️⃣ Ignore it, because the hacker didn't get the code.
2️⃣ Change your email password immediately.
3️⃣ Reply 'STOP' to the text message.
4️⃣ Forward the message to your friend to ask if it is real.

👇 *Drop your answer number and thoughts below.*

💡 _Don't be afraid to get it wrong. The goal is to learn!_

🌙 *KORLINK ANSWER*

🎓 *Cybersecurity*

❓ *Today's Question:*

You suddenly receive a text message with a login security code for your email account, but you didn't try to log in. What should you do right away?

✅ *Correct Answer:*

2️⃣ Change your email password immediately.

🧠 *Why?*

If you get a login code without asking for it, someone already knows your password and is trying to sign in. Changing your password immediately keeps your account safe!

🚀 *BONUS CHALLENGE:*

Check if your email provider lets you log out of all active devices with one click!

🔥 _Keep learning. Keep practicing. Keep building!_

☀️ *KORLINK DAILY TECH POLL*

🎓 *Software Engineering*

👀 *Let's see who gets this!*

👉 *Question:*

You are building a simple shopping app. A user adds three items costing $10 each, but the total displays as $101010 instead of $30! What is most likely causing this bug?

1️⃣ The store database is temporarily offline.
2️⃣ The app is treating the prices as text instead of numbers.
3️⃣ The phone's internet connection was interrupted.
4️⃣ The user's phone screen resolution is too low.

👇 *Drop your answer number and thoughts below.*

💡 _Don't be afraid to get it wrong. The goal is to learn!_

🌙 *KORLINK ANSWER*

🎓 *Software Engineering*

❓ *Today's Question:*

You are building a simple shopping app. A user adds three items costing $10 each, but the total displays as $101010 instead of $30! What is most likely causing this bug?

✅ *Correct Answer:*

2️⃣ The app is treating the prices as text instead of numbers.

🧠 *Why?*

When a computer program treats numbers as text (strings), using the plus sign glues the words together ('10' + '10' + '10' = '101010') instead of adding them mathematically!

🚀 *BONUS CHALLENGE:*

What function or tool in programming would you use to convert text numbers into real integers?

🔥 _Keep learning. Keep practicing. Keep building!_

☀️ *KORLINK DAILY TECH POLL*

🎓 *Network Engineering*

👀 *Let's see who gets this!*

👉 *Question:*

You connect your laptop to your home Wi-Fi and see full signal bars, but no websites will load. What is most likely the issue?

1️⃣ The router is sending a local Wi-Fi signal, but lost its connection to the Internet provider.
2️⃣ Your laptop's Wi-Fi receiver is completely broken.
3️⃣ You entered the wrong Wi-Fi password when connecting.
4️⃣ Your laptop needs a network cable plugged in to browse the web.

👇 *Drop your answer number and thoughts below.*

💡 _Don't be afraid to get it wrong. The goal is to learn!_

🌙 *KORLINK ANSWER*

🎓 *Network Engineering*

❓ *Today's Question:*

You connect your laptop to your home Wi-Fi and see full signal bars, but no websites will load. What is most likely the issue?

✅ *Correct Answer:*

1️⃣ The router is sending a local Wi-Fi signal, but lost its connection to the Internet provider.

🧠 *Why?*

Full Wi-Fi bars mean your laptop is successfully talking to your router locally, but the router itself isn't getting Internet service from your provider.

🚀 *BONUS CHALLENGE:*

What quick physical test or check would you do on the router to see if the Internet cable/line is connected properly?

🔥 _Keep learning. Keep practicing. Keep building!_

☀️ *KORLINK DAILY TECH POLL*

🎓 *Smart Tech and Automation*

👉 *Question:*

You set up a smart system to automatically water your garden every morning. However, it keeps watering even right after a heavy rainstorm! What sensor should you add so it only waters when needed?

1️⃣ Soil moisture sensor
2️⃣ Motion sensor
3️⃣ Sound sensor
4️⃣ Ultrasonic distance sensor

👇 *Drop your answer number and thoughts below.*

💡 _Don't be afraid to get it wrong. The goal is to learn!_
